# Getting started

## Installing and Loading the R Packages

```{r}
pacman::p_load(sf, sfdep, tmap, 
               plotly, tidyverse, 
               Kendall)
```

## Importing geospatial data

```{r}
hunan <- st_read(dsn = "data/geospatial", 
                 layer = "Hunan")
```

## Importing attribute table

```{r}
GDPPC <- read_csv("data/aspatial/Hunan_GDPPC.csv")
```
